iteration_log.object: A physical object, such as a rock.
The initial moment of physical contact between two objects.
A conceptual nexus in a thought experiment.
A mathematical simulation of a physical process.
A basic computer program (script) with no external dependencies.
A hypothetical particle participating in a thought experiment.
A fleeting sensory experience (e.g., a brief flash of light)
A stage of a musical performance (e.g., a single note being played) is a Participation. It is an Occurrent and a Prehension, but it is not necessarily a Process or Relative in the broader sense.
A video recording of a historical event.
A person's desire to win a race.
A mathematical object (e.g., a set) considered as an actuality.
